sources.snippet: Brought to you by the LocalAI team, the folks behind LocalAI, the open-source AI engine that runs any model (LLMs, vision, voice, image, video) on any hardware, no GPU required. A C++17/ ggml port of NVIDIA's NeMo Parakeet speech recognition models, with voice activity detection, speaker diarization and identification, and sound-event tagging.
